lines.text: Wow, a butterfly! Wait, what's a butterfly?
Hi Teacher, we're gonna have a great time today!
I wish every day could be just like today!
Teacher, let's go have a Light Croquette.
What should we do for fun today?
Teacher~ Are you playing hide and seek?
What is this place? It's out of this world!
Can I go to the library and read some books?
Wow, I've never seen anything like this before!
Ah right, I promised to meet with my new teacher today.
I really like this... I think?
What's this? A gift? What is a gift?
There's this warm feeling inside me... I don't understand it. We haven't met before, have we?
I feel so at ease being around you.
This all feels so familiar...but how?
What is this place? Why am I here?
So I just have to shoot?
